newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes flat against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes flat against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost its early edge to close flat at 43.7400/7450 to the dollar in interbank trading ahead of the weekend following a mid-session rise in demand for the greenback from importers, dealers said. Early deals were done at 43.7380 per dollar amid an upward trend in call money rates, but the late-hour transactions were mostly at 43.7450.

The call money was traded at between 6.5 to 10 percent, up from a previous 5.5-9.5 percent. Dealers said the call rates rose slightly due to the outflow of about 1.1 billion taka against purchases of central bank bills, auctioned on Wednesday.
